import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Suppress progress bars
import sys

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from tqdm import tqdm as _tqdm


def main():
    # Ensure submission directory exists
    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

    # Check if sample submission exists to infer column format
    sample_path = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"
    if os.path.exists(sample_path):
        sample_df = pd.read_csv(sample_path, nrows=1)
        sub_template_cols = list(sample_df.columns)
        if len(sub_template_cols) == 1:
            sub_header = sub_template_cols[0]
        else:
            sub_header = "Prediction"
    else:
        sub_header = "Prediction"

    # Load datasets
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

    # Preprocessing function
    def clean_text(text):
        if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str):
            return ""
        text = str(text).strip()
        # Remove surrounding quotes per description
        if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
            text = text[1:-1]
        return text

    # Clean data - remove date column as it's time-based, keep Comment and Insult
    train_clean = train_df[["Comment", "Insult"]].copy()
    test_clean = test_df[["Comment"]].copy()

    train_clean["Comment"] = train_clean["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
    test_clean["Comment"] = test_clean["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

    # Extract features
    X_train_text = train_clean["Comment"].astype(str)
    y_train = train_clean["Insult"].astype(int)
    X_test_text = test_clean["Comment"].astype(str)

    # Stratified split for validation (hold-out) - model trained ONLY on train_split
    X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_idx, y_val_idx = train_test_split(
        X_train_text, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # TF-IDF Vectorization - fit on ALL training data for best feature representation
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=5000,
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.8,
        stop_words="english",
    )
    X_train_tfidf = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_text)  # Fit on ALL train data
    X_val_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(X_val_split)  # Transform only val split
    X_test_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)  # Transform test

    # Classifier (Logistic Regression with balanced weights)
    clf = LogisticRegression(
        max_iter=1000,
        C=1.0,
        solver="lbfgs",
        class_weight="balanced",
        n_jobs=-1,
        random_state=42,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train_idx)  # Train ONLY on train_split

    # Compute Validation AUC-ROC (on the hold-out set the model NEVER trained on)
    proba_val = clf.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]

    positive_ratio = (y_val_idx.sum()) / len(y_val_idx) if len(y_val_idx) > 0 else 0
    negative_ratio = (1 - positive_ratio) if positive_ratio > 0 else 1.0

    if 0 < positive_ratio <= 1 and 0 < negative_ratio <= 1:
        val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_idx, proba_val)
        print(f"\nHold-Out Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.4f}\n")
    else:
        print("\nWarning: Cannot compute AUC due to class imbalance in validation set.")
        val_auc = 0.0

    # Test predictions
    proba_test = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]
    sub_df = pd.DataFrame({sub_header: proba_test})

    # Write to submission
    sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print(
        f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with shape {len(proba_test)}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
